lines.text: You move through the room like you own the night
Whispers follow every step, caught in your spotlight
One look from you could make a good girl sin
You smile like an angel, but I know what’s hiding within
You say all the right things, touch me the right way
But something in your eyes tells me I should run away
You’re velvet lies wrapped in designer suits
I know I should leave, but I keep coming back
You’re velvet lies… and I can’t resist the trap
Champagne in crystal, your hand on my waist
You tell me I’m different, put on that perfect face
We dance real slow while the city burns below
You’re the sweetest kind of trouble that I’ll never let go
You say all the right things, touch me the right way
But something in your eyes tells me I should run away
You’re velvet lies wrapped in designer suits
I know I should leave, but I keep coming back
You’re velvet lies… and I can’t resist the trap
One touch… one kiss…
I already know how this ends
But here I am… falling again
[Final Chorus] (softer then building)
You’re velvet lies wrapped in designer suits
I know I should leave, but the damage is done
You’re velvet lies… and I’m still coming undone
Velvet lies…
